campaign.note: FuzzOpenBytes was driven past 1B executions (1,131,205,714 in 30m, PASS) before fuzz runs were made sandbox-mandatory, so that historical run used the host's 16 workers; its verbatim log is retained. The mandatory sandbox caps a target to 2 CPUs (GOMAXPROCS=2), so a 30m sandboxed run of one target reaches ~1e8 execs, not 1e9. FuzzOpenAuthenticatedBytes runs Open twice plus a BLAKE3 keyed MAC per execution and FuzzStreamBytes builds and reads a whole stream per execution (~3k execs/s), so both are bounded-fuzzed rather than driven to 1B.

note: Every run above executed inside scripts/sandbox.sh (no go ran on the host). No crashes were found. Long campaign: FUZZTIME=60s FUZZTIME_FuzzOpenAuthenticatedBytes=30m sh scripts/fuzz.sh.
